name: AddStamp
caption: Add Stamp

configuration.description: SmartField reference to the record that gets the stamp, written as one placeholder in double braces, e.g. "{{trigger_Rec}}" or "{{FindInvoices_results}}". It must resolve to a Reference (RecordId) in the flow context; surrounding whitespace is ignored. A new step in the editor is prefilled with the first record reference the flow offers (normally the trigger's record).
The stamp text, e.g. "Checked" or "G/L Account: {{glAccount}}". SmartFields are resolved; the result is trimmed and must be 1-250 characters (longer fails the step, it is not cut).

outputs.name: entryNo
outputs.when: always - the entry no. of the new stamp, as text (e.g. "42")

rules.check: configuration.reference must be present and non-empty.
rules.message: Please fill in the highlighted fields.

rules.check: configuration.text must be present and non-empty.
rules.message: Please fill in the highlighted fields.

rules.check: The resolved text, trimmed, must not be longer than 250 characters.
rules.message: The stamp text has %1 characters; a stamp holds at most %2.

rules.check: The resolved text, trimmed, must not be empty (e.g. a SmartField that resolved to nothing).
The reference must resolve to a record reference in the flow context.
The referenced record must still exist when the step runs.
Stamps need a paid AutoFlow licence (a sandbox or a test licence counts as paid). Without one the step fails; the editor shows the same text as a red status line.
rules.message: Stamps need a paid AutoFlow licence.

notes: Reference the output as {{<slug>_entryNo}}, e.g. {{add-stamp_entryNo}} for the default slug.
The stamp's source is the running flow execution; the flow name is stored with the stamp, so it survives the execution clean-up.
Stamps are append-only: they can never be changed or deleted, only canceled once (Cancel Stamp).
The step needs no permission set: it works in the session of whoever triggered the flow. Manual stamping in the UI needs the permission sets 'mse365 AF STAMP' / 'mse365 AF STAMP CNCL'.
To read stamps in a flow, use Find Records on table 5564416 'mse365 AF Stamp' (fields: 1 Entry No., 2 Table No., 3 Record SystemId, 5 Text, 6 Stamped At, 7 Source, 11 Canceled).
Posting a sales/purchase document copies its stamps to the posted documents (invoice, credit memo, shipment, receipt) as new entries.
